rules: Dependencies pass first; serialize overlapping file edits
Tests accompany each ticket; attach observed evidence
P1 and P2 are separate, not P0 gates
No implementation in this planning task

tickets.title: Color capture and decode
tickets.deliverables: Explicit BGR decoder; preserve legacy grayscale; audit capture consumers.
tickets.acceptance: Synthetic color PNG; ADB/Robot BGR shape/dtype; legacy decode; failure.

tickets.title: Region and crop validation
tickets.deliverables: General Region and OcrRegion compatibility; half-open ROI; copy crop.
tickets.acceptance: Full/edge/invalid/inverted/OOB ROI; nested crop; source unchanged.

tickets.title: Pure resize, encode, save
tickets.deliverables: Resize by size/scale; PNG round trip, Unicode save; validation.
tickets.acceptance: Color PNG preserved; dimensions; invalid args; Unicode path; no device dependency.

tickets.title: Platform region observation
tickets.deliverables: snapshot_region/save_snapshot/snapshot_regions delegate pure operations.
tickets.acceptance: Exactly one capture; correct crop/save; failure; old methods intact.

tickets.title: Match compatibility and structured result
tickets.deliverables: Explicit gray/BGR; structured score/bbox/center; preserve legacy MatchPattern.
tickets.acceptance: Color fixtures; invalid template/threshold; bounds and score; legacy tests.

tickets.title: Multi-match and ROI mapping
tickets.deliverables: Bounded find_all, deterministic NMS; supplied image; full-screen offset.
tickets.acceptance: Overlapping/multiple matches; no-match; limit; ordering; ROI and one capture.

tickets.title: Template OCR regression
tickets.deliverables: Convert at OCR boundary; validate; prevent non-terminating loop; preserve API.
tickets.acceptance: BGR/gray same result; empty templates; constant/zero-threshold edge; bounded.

tickets.title: Generic compare and polling
tickets.deliverables: Changed-pixel ratio/tolerance; monotonic wait_image; no agent state.
tickets.acceptance: Known diff ratios; invalid shape; fake clock timeout and bounded polling.

tickets.title: ADB typed process results
tickets.deliverables: Typed argv, exit code, timeout and explicit serial; raw exec compatibility.
tickets.acceptance: Nonzero without error text; warning on success; timeout; literal arguments; serial; start_app regression.

tickets.title: Generic action capabilities
tickets.deliverables: Long press when supported; explicit unsupported; safe desktop defaults.
tickets.acceptance: Mock actions and duration; invalid/unsupported; failsafe; no real input.

tickets.title: Independent Core acceptance
tickets.deliverables: Regression and dependency boundary; NB read-only snapshot/crop if online.
tickets.acceptance: Baseline + new suite; actual dimensions/color/ROI; no device mutation; blockers distinguished.

tickets.title: Installable package and headless imports
tickets.deliverables: Optional desktop extra, lazy imports, legacy wrappers.
tickets.acceptance: Fresh venv install; ADB import without pyautogui; old entry/script tests.

tickets.title: GUI compatibility
tickets.deliverables: Wails/Go integration paths; official installer retained; no redesign.
tickets.acceptance: Go tests/build when available; Python legacy smoke; explicit toolchain blocker.

tickets.title: Application session/frame store
tickets.deliverables: Persistent bounded workspace/device scoped frames; composable transforms.
tickets.acceptance: Across processes; nested crop/resize; traversal and wrong-device rejection; atomic storage.

tickets.title: Observation CLI and export
tickets.deliverables: devices/snapshot/crop/resize/capabilities, JSON and exit conventions.
tickets.acceptance: Actual subprocess; parse stdout; PNG file/dimensions; usage exit 2; single capture.

tickets.title: Assets and matching refs
tickets.deliverables: Register/list/match/all on named assets and frame; scoped refs.
tickets.acceptance: Persistence; safe names; no-match; correct bbox/score/device.

tickets.title: Action refs and coordinate mapping
tickets.deliverables: Click frame point/ref, swipe/type/key; freshness/bounds/serial; receipt.
tickets.acceptance: Exact mapping of resized crop; stale/mismatch reject; timeout status; no retries.

tickets.title: State waits and verification
tickets.deliverables: Changed/stable/image waits with ROI, baseline, timeout; generic compare.
tickets.acceptance: Fake clock/noisy ROI/stable/timeout; bounded captures; separate action status.

tickets.title: MCP adapter and image delivery
tickets.deliverables: Discover actual Queqiao NB contract; shared methods; image content + metadata.
tickets.acceptance: Discovery/schema; PNG MIME+bytes; actual visible image; scoped errors.

tickets.title: Controlled MuMu acceptance
tickets.deliverables: Verify serial; capture/crop/register/match; scoped test target tap and verify.
tickets.acceptance: Actual image, correct coordinates, one intended action and postcondition; no other device/account/desktop effects.

tickets.title: Optional performance extensions
tickets.deliverables: Profile first; bounded invalidating cache, optional separate color/multiscale design.
tickets.acceptance: Benchmark, invalidation, accuracy; no mandatory model dependency.
